lines: // A required outcome stays unfinished until its token is known, even when no step can produce it.
.decl unproduced_goal(run: symbol, goal: symbol, token: symbol)
// An outstanding operation can confirm an unfinished step despite a missing prerequisite.
eligible(run, step, _), !waiting_done(run, step), completion(run, step, token, _),
// An undecided safety check can still be resolved by additional evidence.
// An outstanding operation can still supply a goal that no step produces.
// A supplied deferral of an unblocked step at the current cut withholds the fixed point.
// A pending effect of an unfinished step keeps the fixed point open until a readback settles it.
.decl fixed_point(run: symbol, sweep: symbol, step: symbol, token: symbol, requirement: symbol)
// Account for an unfinished goal without a producer. The goal record is its own requirement.
// A current, explicitly complete dated sweep closes the round as well, also when it brought no new values.
complete_current_sweep(run, sweep), waiting(run, step, token, requirement), !possible_progress(run).
